name: 2dtag
description: A 2D multiplayer tag game with hosted lobbies, join codes, 19 maps (guns, invisibility, hide-and-seek, 5x speed, candy freeze, a low-gravity moon map, a flipped-gravity double-coin map, a map with random mini-superpower orbs, a musical-chairs elimination map, a map where getting tagged turns you into Frankenstein's monster, a map where evaders can build walls to block the tagger, a map where an unpredictable tide sweeps the tower and eliminates anyone not on a platform, and a map with mystery boxes you open and throw at other players), skins, trails, quests, 20 music tracks and bots.
